Title: Hydroponic Cucumbers: pH, EC, Temperature & Pruning Guide
Description: Hydroponic cucumbers: pH 5.5–6.0, EC about 2.0, 75–85 °F days, nights above 60–65 °F, 12–18 in apart. First fruit 50–70 days from seed. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: hydroponic cucumbers, hydroponics, indoor gardening, grow vegetables indoors
